description: Production deployment governance. Tests must pass before deploy; human approval gates the final push.

trace_rules.description: Inject a reminder when entering the deploying state to confirm tests passed. The state machine guards enforce this structurally; this rule adds a prompt-level reinforcement.
trace_rules.payload: Reminder: confirm that all tests passed before proceeding with deployment.

trace_rules.description: Deny a second deploy attempt if no new test run has occurred since the last deploy command (detect rerun loops without retesting).
trace_rules.payload: Two consecutive Bash calls in deploying state detected. Ensure you are not rerunning a failed deploy without re-testing first.
